description: Keyword search over the federal statistical data cubes on LINDAS (the data behind visualize.admin.ch): electricity prices (ElCom), energy statistics (BFE), environment/air/water (BAFU), agriculture (FOAG), traffic counts (ASTRA), population and economy (BFS) and more. Every word must appear (case-insensitive) in the cube's name, description, publisher or IRI, in any language (German terms often match best, e.g. 'Strompreis', 'Luft', 'Verkehr'). Returns cube IRI, name, trimmed description, publisher, last-modified date and a visualize.admin.ch link. Deprecated cube versions are excluded; published cubes shown on visualize.admin.ch rank first. Next step: describe_data_cube {cube: <IRI>}. Examples: {query: 'electricity price'}, {query: 'Treibhausgas', lang: 'de'}, {query: 'bfe energie', limit: 10}.

lang.description: Preferred language for names/descriptions (falls back to de/fr/it/en)

published_only.description: Exclude cubes whose status is Draft

query.description: Keywords (all must match). Empty lists the most recently modified cubes.

name: search_data_cubes
title: Search LINDAS statistical data cubes
